strict_gate_interpretation: All listed literal payload differences are genuine failures of the unchanged exact action-list comparison. They are separated from command/target/route/key differences and do not alone establish a lexical or acoustic recognition error. No punctuation/case normalization, adjusted scores or expected-plan changes are applied.
causal_limit: Descriptions compare saved prompt text, recognized text and plans. They do not establish what was acoustically spoken, an accent/noise cause, clipping, hint contamination or model-internal cause. No audio was listened to or decoded during consolidation.
latency_interpretation: All three measured p95 values exceed the 300 ms performance goal. The Stage 3 text permits reporting measured latency and its limits instead of treating 300 ms as a mandatory hard gate. Times here are estimated last-speech-to-final from paced replay and common Silero speech-end estimates, not manually annotated/live end-to-end session timings.

review_from_completed_turbo_analysis.qualification: Supported by one unique recording; other engines decoding that same WAV are not independent recording evidence.

alias_review.reason_no_large_gain: Large returns Clause Claw; aliasing Claw does not repair the unsupported command verb Clause.

alias_review.collision_result_scope: Individual Turbo analysis found no installed-name, whole-word installed-name or existing-alias collisions and no regressions among these 40 parsed transcripts. This is a scoped review, not a guarantee for future commands.
